name: plexus
description: Plexus — a diagram editor built on @visualisation-sub/mural, packaged as an Electron desktop app (electron-vite). Sibling app in the mural repo: consumes mural through its published package surface (no relative ../src imports, no internals), so extracting to its own repo later is a config change, not a rewrite.

scripts.//: compile:mu compiles the mural UI .mu -> .mu.js via the mural CLI (Vite then bundles it). dev runs electron-vite with HMR; build produces the packaged renderer/main/preload under out/. Rebuild the repo-root dist (npm run build there) when framework source changes — the renderer bundles mural's built dist.
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
